title: Augmented positive-power cone tower of a chain endomorphism
statement: Let A be an abelian category with countable products and P a cochain complex. For an endomorphism μ of P define C_n=Cone(μ^(n+1)), with adjacent square (μ,1), hence transition C_(n+1)→C_n. The degree-zero inclusions P→C_n form a compatible augmentation. Put Λ_μ(P)=Cone(1-shift:∏C_n→∏C_n)[-1], and define P→Λ_μ(P) by the product of inclusions and zero homotopy. These are actual chain constructions; no regularity or flatness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0999, 099B and 0A0E; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0941 for the normalized strict Roos model

proof.text: The endomorphism power recursion proves that (μ,1) is a commuting square. Functor.ofOpSequence gives the tower. Cone map formulas show that the target inclusions are compatible.

After every product projection the augmentation followed by 1-shift is the difference of equal compatible inclusions, so is zero. The mapping-cocone lift with zero homotopy defines the normalized unit.
